description: This file defines a report for incorrect stock value discrepancies in an ERP system, including functions to fetch data, calculate expected stock values, and generate report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_unsync_date
methods.description: Calculates the earliest date where stock and account balances are synchronized.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Retrieves and processes stock ledger entries to identify discrepancies.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure of the report columns.
